shadows.name: pixel-text-drop
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow for pixel labels and the tagline over the scene; key labels use 0 2px var(--red-deep).

shadows.name: key-bevel
shadows.value: inset 0 2px var(--gold), inset 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cinnabar-red) 70%, var(--gold)), inset 0 -4px var(--red-press)
shadows.purpose: Lit top edge and pressed-in base of the red power-up key.

shadows.name: key-bevel-active
shadows.purpose: The pressed key: face inset 2px 2px 4px, key moved down 2px.

shadows.name: logotype-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter that lifts /title.png off the scene.

shadows.name: phosphor-glow
shadows.value: 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 55%, transparent), 0 0 10px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cinnabar-red) 60%, transparent), 0 0 26px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cinnabar-red) 28%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow on .glow pixel section titles only, only while effects are on.

shadows.name: scene-bloom
shadows.value: mix-blend-mode: screen; filter: contrast(2.4) brightness(.85) blur(10px); opacity: .6
shadows.purpose: Second canvas over the scene; part of the effects layer.

shadows.name: scanlines
shadows.purpose: One dark row per native scene pixel; effects layer, never over prose.

motion.name: scene-tick
motion.purpose: The attract loop: star twinkle, clouds stepping one native pixel, embers, glint sweep every 54 ticks.

motion.name: ui-step
motion.purpose: Header link and chevron state changes.

motion.name: dialog-reveal
motion.value: .24s steps(4, end); clip-path inset(50% 0) to inset(0 0)
motion.purpose: Dialogs open like a CRT line expanding.

motion.name: press-start-blink
motion.purpose: PRESS START blinks three times then holds; effects on and no reduced motion only.

motion.name: key-press
motion.purpose: Every pressable key moves down one art pixel on :active.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: scroll offset × 0.5 / 0.45 / 0.38 / 0.26 / 0.14 / 0.06, rounded to native pixels
motion.purpose: Sky, clouds, far, mid and near layers on the surface scene; off when effects are off or motion is reduced.

motion.name: operate-fade
motion.purpose: Background and border colour fades on marketplace and book controls only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion or Effects off: tick 0, no embers, no sweep, no parallax, no blink.

narrative.overview:
Cinnabar's site is an arcade cabinet left running in a dark room. The home page is its attract-mode screen: an original pixel world drawn in code, a score line of real numbers along the top, and PRESS START as the download. The world is a warm phosphor-black night over blocky hills, lit from below by a glowing formation of cinnabar crystals, with a pixel moon, stars and block clouds overhead. Everything around it is built from the same materials: hard-edged pixel boxes with two-step corners, pixel caps for labels and titles, and one red key.

The cabinet has two registers. Persuade surfaces (home, `/mod/`) run the full world: the canvas scene, the riveted cabinet frames, the phosphor glow on pixel titles, the stepped high-score chart and the select screen. Operate and Read surfaces (`/mods/`, `/docs/modding/`) keep the world's ground, corners, pixel-caps labels and red focus, and leave standard controls, a crisp grotesk and calm reading columns alone. Density is moderate. The scene and the frames carry the character so the text can stay plain.

The world rejects two things by construction: the dimmed-screenshot hero, and the generic dark page with a neon accent. It is not a Minecraft imitation either. It draws its own world, never borrows the game's font or Mojang's UI textures, and shows the game only through the owner's own captures.
keyCharacteristics: A seeded pixel world drawn on `<canvas>` at runtime, scaled by whole device pixels, never a shipped image.
One sixteen-colour sprite palette: cool night blues plus warm ramps hue-shifted from the icon red.
Pixel boxes everywhere: nine-slice SVG frames with 2px stepped corners, zero radius, no glass.
Silkscreen pixel caps only at multiples of its 8px grid. Prose is always Archivo.
One red action family, the power-up key, with a gold top edge and a pressed-in shade.
A capability layer of scanlines, bloom and phosphor glow behind a visible Effects switch. Reduced motion gives a still frame.

rules.name: The Icon Red Rule
rules.body: The red is read from the icon's fill at build time and enters the page only as `--cinnabar-red`. Every red step is a `color-mix` from it, and every warm scene colour is a hue shift of it. Never type a red hex into a stylesheet, template or script.

rules.name: The One Power-Up Rule
rules.body: Red fills belong to one family: the stepped red key (the download, its mode key, the marketplace's "Add to Cinnabar") and the MOD cartridge tag that shares its material. Every other control is a neutral pixel box or an ink key. Elsewhere red appears only as small marks, such as a cursor, a lit pixel, a square bullet, the chart line, a frame edge or focus.

rules.name: The Gold Pixel Rule
rules.body: Gold is the top edge of a red key and nothing else.

rules.name: The Grid Multiple Rule
rules.body: Silkscreen is set only at 16, 24, 32, 48 or 64px, the multiples of its 8px grid. It is always uppercase, with letter-spacing 0 and font smoothing switched off. On phones the nav keeps 16px and swaps to short labels rather than shrinking.

rules.name: The Prose Is Never Pixel Rule
rules.body: Sentences, descriptions, the warning, hints, captions that explain things, and all marketplace and book content are set in Archivo. Pixel caps carry names, numbers and short commands only.

rules.name: The Logotype Is the Display Rule
rules.body: The largest name on a page is always `/title.png`. Never set "Cinnabar" as a type headline or redraw the logotype.

rules.name: The Effects Stop at Prose Rule
rules.body: Scanlines, bloom and glow apply to the canvas, the chart screen and pixel titles. They never cover the warning, the tagline, captions, the book or the marketplace, and the book and marketplace have no effects layer at all.

rules.name: The Still Frame Rule
rules.body: With effects off, or under `prefers-reduced-motion`, the world settles on one still frame: tick zero, no embers, no glint sweep and no parallax, with PRESS START not blinking. The Effects switch defaults to off when reduced motion is set, remembers the visitor's choice in `localStorage`, and switches scanlines, bloom and glow together. Reduced motion stops the scene even if a visitor has turned the effects back on.

rules.name: The Two-Step Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners are cut in whole 2px steps and never rounded. A `border-radius` above zero is outside the system.

dos: **Do** read the red from the icon through `@@RED@@` and `--cinnabar-red`, and derive every other red with `color-mix` from it.
**Do** use `/title.png` as the largest name on any Persuade surface.
**Do** draw new pixel art in code from the sixteen-colour palette, at whole-pixel scale with `image-rendering: pixelated`, and dither between palette steps rather than blending.
**Do** frame panels with the nine-slice pixel boxes and cut corners in 2px steps; keep `border-radius` at 0.
**Do** set Silkscreen only at 16, 24, 32, 48 or 64px, uppercase, with smoothing off.
**Do** put new red actions in the power-up key family, and use the Ink Key or Pixel Box Key for everything else.
**Do** mark current or selected items with the 6×10 Red Line menu cursor.
**Do** show live numbers only from the real API, and show `--` in Quiet when they are missing.
**Do** keep the Effects switch visible wherever a scene runs, and freeze to a still frame under reduced motion.
**Do** keep targets at 44px or more and focus rings at 2px Red Line, or Ink on red keys.
donts: **Don't** hardcode a red hex anywhere in the site's code.
**Don't** set prose, descriptions, warnings, hints or book and marketplace content in pixel type.
**Don't** apply scanlines, bloom or glow over prose, or add an effects layer to the book or the marketplace.
**Don't** imitate the Minecraft font or Mojang UI textures, or ship Mojang assets. The game appears only in the owner's captures.
**Don't** filter, tint or crop captures into decoration. They sit unaltered in frames and bezels.
**Don't** ship generated or stock rasters for the world. The scenes are drawn at runtime.
**Don't** use frosted glass, `backdrop-filter`, rounded corners or soft elevation cards for interface boxes.
**Don't** make the WARNING panel blink or hide it below decorative content.
**Don't** use gold anywhere except the top edge of a red key.

**Don't** let world motion glide. The scene ticks at 12fps in whole pixels, Persuade-surface state changes and dialog reveals step (`steps()`), and only the marketplace's and book's standard controls keep their short 0.12–0.15s ease-out colour fades.
